rotary_priming.scope: Source-bound CPU FP32 priming to2054 before FP16/device conversion, preserving the existing2048 prefix and forbidding subsequent cache rebuilds. Fixed2048 sequence length and seven heads require no larger cache. This is a new recipe and does not assert parity with unprimed legacy FP16 cache reconstruction.

checkpoint_and_named_hook_coverage.scope: Actual per-parameter pre-reduction callback observations in every qualification update, source-bound to the explicit nonreentrant adapter or direct-function reference. These observations complement independently reconstructed raw moments and masters; they do not independently recompute the entire network derivative.

schedules.scope: independent masks, eligibility Boolean intersections, paired schedules and committed exposure only; not independent GPU argmax recomputation or tokenizer replay

state_comparisons.limitation: Compares actual retained source-bound state identities and scalar traces. Does not independently unpickle/recompute full raw ZeRO model/Adam/scaler states; checkpoint inventory and loader assertions remain separate evidence.

suffix.bounds: At fixed production shape, retained real-prefix teacher/head logits and scaled logit gradients require tensor equality, treating signed zero as equal; normalized head and total CE absolute difference<=5e-5. Full owned pre-step partition/state/update traces require exact equality. A numerical mismatch is not waived by the former decoder policy.

verifier_change_scope: Normalize only the source-proven in-place removal of registered AdamW adam_w_modeTrue under the exact reviewed DeepSpeed implementation and zero weight decay; preserve all raw tensor identities, numerical bounds and other recipe checks.
